title: 第1章 姬家长空
content_zh:
又一次从睡梦中痛醒，姬长空从木床上坐起来，往窗外看了一眼，天刚蒙蒙亮。快速地穿上青衣，双手捧了一把冷水在脸上随便搓揉了一把，姬长空就亟不可待地往外跑去

一年之计在于春，一日之计在于晨，然而对姬长空来说，早晨却并不是一个好时光。

匆匆来到伙房，捋起衣袖，姬长空立即开始忙活起来。添材、生火、加水、和面，他这一连串动作无比娴熟，明显不是第一次做这些事情了。

外面传来一阵阵暴响，那是拳裂青石、脚碎坚木的声音，姬家儿郎都在趁着早晨锻炼皮肉、筋骨，以期望能够在天士修炼的艰苦道路上更进一步。

在伙房正在炒莴笋的姬长空，听着外面青岩被大力碎裂的声音，愣了一下神，脸上忽然多了几分落寞，轻叹一声，姬长空又将注意力放在锅内的莴笋上面，却暗呼一声糟糕――莴笋炒过了。

“长空啊，早饭好了没有？今天城主大人会过来，三年一度的姬家天士测炼，辰时就要开始了，我们要快一点啊！”门来传来一声悦耳的女声，声音才落下一会儿，姬婉云就已来到了伙房。

“姑姑，马上就好了。”姬长空回头露齿一笑，那张被烟灰熏黑的小脸上，姬长空本就洁白的牙齿更显明亮。

看着那张被熏黑的小脸上展露出的灿烂笑容，姬婉云心中没来由的一阵心酸，心中叹息了一声，姬婉云上前一步，伸出芊芊玉手帮姬长空擦拭脸上的灰尘。

姬长空马上放下手中的锅铲，急着后退了两步，转身以后背对着姬婉云将蒸好的馒头一个个摆放在台架上，这才轻声道：“姑姑，我脸上脏，待会洗洗就好了，别把你的手也给弄脏了。”

“你这孩子！说什么呢？”姬婉云突然生气了，身子翩然一晃，就已到了姬长空面前，她左手闪电般扣住姬长空的肩膀，让他无法躲避，右手在姬长空脸上继续着刚刚没做完的事情――擦拭起他脸上的乌黑。

然而，姬婉云没有沾水的右手在姬长空脸上抹来抹去，不但没能将他脸上的乌黑拭去，反而让他脸上像鬼画符一样难看。

“姑姑，都说了不用擦了，看看，把你的手都给弄脏了吧？”姬长空心中感动，知道谁对自己好。

“脏了再洗！”姬婉云轻喝一声，脸色一正，肃然道：“长空，不管别人怎么说你，怎么看你，在姑姑眼中，你永远都是姬家最好的孩子！”

“知道姑姑疼我。”姬长空笑了笑，抬手小心地捋去姬婉云那遮住左颊的长发，看着她光滑左颊上从眉角一直延伸到洁白脖颈的四道狰狞疤痕，姬长空眼神坚定，道：“姑姑，我可能永远没能力为你报仇，但我一定会想办法为你将脸上这四道疤痕消掉！”

姬婉云脸上四道疤痕像是四条丑陋的小蛇盘踞在脸上，将姬婉云本来美貌的容颜全部破坏，从那疤痕的痕迹可以看出那是被人用尖利的指甲硬生生划出来的！

疤痕那么深，可以想象当初那人的指甲一定深陷在她皮肉内，那种痛苦可想而知……

身体的痛苦是一方面，心灵的痛苦更是令人绝望！

对一个女人，尤其是一个曾经美貌的女人来说，最残忍最恶毒的报复莫过于此！

“别说胡话了，姑姑只要知道你有这份心就够了。”姬婉云眼神闪烁，脸上有些慌乱，赶紧又用长发将左脸颊的四道狰狞疤痕遮住，这才帮姬长空将馒头和几碟小菜摆好，道：“走吧，那些姬家的大小男人可都没什么耐性，怕是要等得急了。”

姬长空两手攥紧，越来越用力，指甲深陷进肉里，直到他感觉到了那种锥心般的刺痛，才松开来。深吸一口气，将紊乱的心境平复下来，姬长空把剩下的几碗清粥端起，默默地跟在姬婉云身后走出伙房。

长桌上摆着几碟小菜，两大笼白馒头，人前一碗清粥。

姬逾兴、姬逾胜两位老人坐在上席，左边是姬逾兴两个儿子姬昊宏、姬昊广，孙子姬长啸、姬长生、姬长乐。右边第一人是姬逾胜女儿姬婉云，然后是姬昊广的大女儿姬月晴，姬昊宏的小女儿姬小莲，姬长空最后。

姬家饭桌除上席座位外，男人靠左，女人靠右，本来姬长空应该坐在左边，但是大桌子也不够长，只能够挪到右边，和姬家女人为伍。

还有一张小桌子，姬昊宏、姬昊广两人的妻子罗氏、赵氏，也在低头等待着。

不是姬家人，进了姬家门，都没资格上大桌。大桌上面，坐着的永远都只是姓姬的。

有姬逾兴、姬逾胜两人在，饭桌上面一向比较安静，这两人不讲话，子孙都闭口，这是规矩。

话罢，姬逾兴率先拣了一小片莴笋，咀嚼了一下，轻轻皱了皱眉头，倒也没说什么。姬逾兴一动筷子，大家相继出筷，竹筷子在几碟小菜上面晃动起来。

姬长空心中一紧，突然想起刚刚忙着和姬婉云讲话，一时不慎，竟然将这一碟炒过了的莴笋端上来了。偷偷打量了姬逾兴一眼，见姬逾兴没有兴师问罪的意思，姬长空才暗暗松了一口气。

“扑！”姬长乐苦着脸，一片莴笋被他吐在了面前桌子上，狠狠地瞪了对面的姬长空一眼，姬长乐赶紧低头，“呼啦呼啦”地猛喝粥。

“呃……是莴笋炒过了，不过小乐这孩子，也真是的。”姬长乐的父亲姬昊广笑着为他儿子开脱。姬家家规严厉，在饭桌上面刚刚姬长乐的行为已是不检，姬昊广生怕父亲姬逾兴责怪孙子，佯装无意地将责任推到姬长空身上。

“是炒过了。”姬昊宏点了点头，瞥了那边垂着头的姬长空一眼，淡淡道：“长空啊，下次可要认真一点哦。”

“知道了，大伯。明天我会将菜烧好，不会让您吃不下的。”姬长空低着头，眼中闪过一丝恚怒，嘴里面却温和地轻声道。

姬长空的亲爷爷姬逾胜，重重地将手中的瓷碗放下，突然怒道：“烧菜烧菜！就知道烧菜！堂堂姬家男儿，只会在这种低贱的事情上面下功夫，你还能有什么出息？”

顿了顿，姬逾胜见姬长空垂着头一声不吭，又猛拍了一下桌子，再次怒斥道：“明明知道今天有贵客上门，还弄得一身脏，连件干净衣服都不换，不识大体！”话语方落，姬逾胜连手中的筷子都扔了，冷哼一声站了起来。

姬逾胜的爆发来的有些突兀，事先没有任何预兆，众人面面相觑，都暂时放下手中碗筷，愣愣地看着他。

之前狠狠地瞪了姬长空一眼的姬长乐，眼中满是幸灾乐祸，姬长啸、姬长生、姬月晴三人，一副事不关己的模样，看都不看姬长空，只是有些奇怪地望着姬逾胜，不明白他为何因为这么一件小事发这么大的怒火。

姬昊宏、姬昊广两人正襟危坐，神情严肃，而坐在旁边小桌子上的他们的妻子罗氏、赵氏两妇人，则是轻轻低着头，脸上挂着不易察觉的冷笑。

只有姬长空旁边的姬小莲，怯怯地轻扯一下姬长空衣角，眼眸中满是同情。

“爹！”姬婉云站了起来，毫不畏惧地望着姬逾胜，愤然道：“长空要不是身体始终不能够聚集元力，他不会比任何人差！长空身为姬家直系子弟，为大家每日烧饭已经够辛苦的了，偶尔一次疏忽也在所难免，您还要生他的气？！”

“咳……”一直低头继续喝粥的姬逾兴，到此时才终于抬头，放下碗筷，但却没有站起来的意思，望着姬逾胜，皱眉道：“三弟，就是因为长空不能够聚集元力成为天士，我又看他厨艺非凡才让他打理每日膳食的。我也只是想给他找点事做，反正他又不能够修炼，省的他无聊嘛。你要是不喜，我重新找个人替换他好了，何必生那么大气呢？”

“他笨手笨脚的，烧的菜反正我是不喜欢吃！”姬逾胜狠狠地瞪了姬长空一眼，甩手就走，到了门外才低声喃喃道：“小舟烧的菜好吃，我就中意他！”

“昊宏，明日开始，还是让小舟继续负责每日膳食。”在姬逾胜身影还未消失之前，姬逾兴对大儿子姬昊宏轻喝道。

“知道了，爹。”姬昊宏点头应诺，无意地瞥了一眼低头一言不发的姬长空，眼中闪过一丝不悦。

“城主该来了，你们快点吃完，早点去青岩山准备测炼。哪个小兔崽子来迟了，关寒冰洞三天！”姬逾兴起身，正准备离开，突然无意地扫了姬长空一眼，想了一下，才皱着眉头道：“长空就留下来收拾桌子，反正你也不能够聚集元力，这次的测炼你来不来都无所谓。”话罢，姬逾兴身影一晃，实力达到六合天的他已转瞬不见。

姬逾兴一走，姬昊宏、姬昊广看都不看姬长空一眼，只是对姬婉云点了点头，用湿布抹了一巴嘴也随即离去，那边两人的妻子罗氏、赵氏紧随其后。

“等测炼结束了我再收拾你，哼！”姬长乐狠狠地瞪了姬长空一眼，也顾不得继续吃饭了，经过姬长空身旁的时候，用只有他们两人能够听到的声音低声说了一句。然后才和姬长啸、姬长生两人一起急匆匆地往青岩山行去，生怕去迟了会被关寒冰洞三天。

“长空哥哥，都怪长乐哥哥乱吐，才让三爷爷生气的，你别伤心啊。”姬小莲扯了扯姬长空的衣角，明亮的大眼睛，圆圆的小脸蛋，撅着小嘴轻声安慰姬长空。

“走了小莲，你不是想被关寒冰洞吧？”姬月晴皱了皱眉头，不等姬长空开口就轻喝道，她似乎不喜欢姬小莲和姬长空多接触，一把抓住姬小莲，还没等她讲话说完，就硬拽着她往外扯。

姬小莲吐了吐小舌头，对姬长空挥了挥手，跟着姬月晴一起往外奔去。

当膳房只剩下他和姬婉云两人的时候，一直垂首的姬长空将最后一口粥喝个干干净净，这才抬头，脸上竟然还挂着淡淡的笑容，仿佛根本不受被姬逾胜大骂的影响，不气不躁，宠辱不惊。

“长空，不要怪你爷爷，整个姬家，最疼你的不是姑姑，而是你爷爷！”见所有人都走了，姬婉云才轻叹一声，幽幽道。

“姑姑，我自然知道爷爷这么做是因为心疼我。哎，是我自己不争气，也难为爷爷了，为了让我可以省些力气，他居然还要废这么大功夫。”姬长空叹息道。

姬长空这么一说，姬婉云嫣然失笑，摸了摸姬长空的头，欣慰道：“你这孩子，就是比那几个小混蛋聪明懂事，总是这么让人放心，你要是有朝一日能够聚集元力修炼成天士，我看长乐那几个混蛋，一个都比不过你！”

content_en:
Waking up painfully from his sleep again, Ji Changkong sat up from the wooden bed and glanced out the window. It was just dawn.Ji Changkong quickly put on his green clothes, held a handful of cold water in both hands and rubbed his face casually, and then ran out eagerly.

A year's plan begins with spring, and a day's plan begins with morning. However, for Ji Changkong, morning is not a good time.

Ji Changkong hurried to the kitchen, rolled up his sleeves, and immediately started working.Adding ingredients, making fire, adding water, and kneading dough, this series of actions he performed was extremely skillful. It was obviously not the first time he had done these things.

There were bursts of violent sounds outside, the sound of fists cracking bluestone and feet breaking solid wood. The children of the Ji family were taking advantage of the morning to exercise their skin, flesh, muscles and bones, hoping to take a step further on the arduous path of Tianshi cultivation.

Ji Changkong, who was frying lettuce in the kitchen, was stunned for a moment when he heard the sound of green rocks being broken by force outside. His face suddenly became a little lonely. He sighed softly. Ji Changkong focused on the lettuce in the pot, but secretly exclaimed that it was bad - the lettuce was over fried.

"Changkong, is breakfast ready? The Lord of the City will come over today. The triennial Ji family's heavenly warrior test is about to start at Chen Shi. We have to hurry up!" A pleasant female voice came from the door. After the voice fell for a while, Ji Wanyun had already arrived in the kitchen.

"Aunt, you'll be fine soon." Ji Changkong turned around and smiled. On his little face blackened by soot, Ji Changkong's already white teeth were even brighter.

Looking at the bright smile on the blackened little face, Ji Wanyun felt sad for no reason, and sighed in her heart. Ji Wanyun stepped forward and stretched out her jade hand to help Ji Changkong wipe the dust from her face.

Ji Changkong immediately put down the spatula in his hand, hurriedly took two steps back, turned his back to Ji Wanyun, and placed the steamed buns one by one on the stand. Then he said softly: "Auntie, my face is dirty. Just wash it later. Don't make your hands dirty too."

"You kid! What are you talking about?" Ji Wanyun suddenly became angry. With a sway, she was already in front of Ji Changkong. Her left hand clasped Ji Changkong's shoulder like lightning, making it impossible for him to avoid it. Her right hand continued what she had not finished on Ji Changkong's face - wiping away the darkness on his face.

However, Ji Wanyun's right hand, which was not wet with water, wiped Ji Changkong's face. Not only did it fail to wipe away the blackness on his face, but it made his face look as ugly as a ghost painting.

"Auntie, I told you not to wipe it. Look, are your hands dirty?" Ji Changkong was moved and knew who was kind to him.

"Wash it after it's dirty!" Ji Wanyun shouted softly, straightened her face, and said solemnly: "Changkong, no matter what others say about you or think of you, in the eyes of my aunt, you will always be the best child of the Ji family!"

"I know my aunt loves me." Ji Changkong smiled and raised his hand to carefully brush away Ji Wanyun's long hair that covered her left cheek. Looking at the four hideous scars on her smooth left cheek that extended from the corner of her eyebrow to her white neck, Ji Changkong's eyes were firm and he said: "Aunt, I may never be able to avenge you, but I will definitely find a way to remove these four scars on your face for you!"

The four scars on Ji Wanyun's face were like four ugly little snakes entangled on her face, completely destroying Ji Wanyun's originally beautiful appearance. From the traces of the scars, it can be seen that they were cut out by someone with sharp nails!

The scar is so deep, you can imagine that the person's nails must have been deeply dug into her flesh. You can imagine the pain...

The physical pain is one thing, the mental pain is even more despairing!

For a woman, especially a once-beautiful woman, there is nothing more cruel and vicious revenge than this!

"Stop talking nonsense, it's enough for my aunt to know that you have this heart." Ji Wanyun's eyes flickered, her face was a little flustered, and she quickly covered the four hideous scars on her left cheek with her long hair. Then she helped Ji Changkong place the steamed buns and a few dishes of side dishes, and said, "Let's go, the men of the Ji family don't have much patience, I'm afraid they will be impatient to wait."

Ji Changkong clenched his hands harder and harder, digging his nails into his flesh. He didn't let go until he felt the heart-piercing pain.Taking a deep breath to calm down his chaotic mood, Ji Changkong picked up the remaining bowls of porridge and silently followed Ji Wanyun out of the kitchen.

There were several plates of side dishes on the long table, two large cages of white steamed buns, and a bowl of clear porridge in front of the person.

Two old men, Ji Yuxing and Ji Yusheng, were sitting at the upper table. On the left were Ji Yuxing's two sons, Ji Haohong and Ji Haoguang, and his grandsons Ji Changxiao, Ji Changsheng and Ji Changle.The first person on the right is Ji Yusheng's daughter Ji Wanyun, then Ji Haoguang's eldest daughter Ji Yueqing, Ji Haohong's youngest daughter Ji Xiaolian, and Ji Changkong last.

Except for the seats at the Ji family's dinner table, men sit on the left and women sit on the right. Originally, Ji Changkong should sit on the left, but the big table is not long enough, so he can only move to the right to be with the women of the Ji family.

There is also a small table, and the wives of Ji Haohong and Ji Haoguang, Luo Shi and Zhao, are also waiting with their heads down.

If you are not a member of the Ji family, you will not be qualified to sit at the big table if you enter the Ji family.At the big table, the only person surnamed Ji is always sitting.

With Ji Yuxing and Ji Yusheng present, the dinner table was always quiet. These two people did not speak, and the descendants kept silent. This was the rule.

After speaking, Ji Yuxing took the lead in picking up a small piece of lettuce, chewed it, frowned slightly, but didn't say anything.Ji Yuxing moved his chopsticks, and everyone took out their chopsticks one after another. The bamboo chopsticks swayed on several plates of side dishes.

Ji Changkong's heart tightened, and he suddenly remembered that he was busy talking to Ji Wanyun just now, and he accidentally served this plate of fried lettuce.After secretly taking a look at Ji Yuxing, Ji Changkong breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that Ji Yuxing had no intention of raising an army to hold him accountable.

"Plop!" Ji Changle made a bitter face and spat out a piece of lettuce on the table in front of him. He glared at Ji Changkong who was opposite him. Ji Changle quickly lowered his head and drank the porridge with a "hula hula" sound.

"Uh...it's because the lettuce has been fried, but Xiaole, this kid, it's true." Ji Changle's father, Ji Haoguang, smiled and defended his son.The Ji family has strict rules, and Ji Changle's behavior at the dinner table was already inappropriate. Ji Haoguang was afraid that his father Ji Yuxing would blame his grandson, so he pretended to unintentionally shift the responsibility to Ji Changkong.

"It's been fired." Ji Haohong nodded, glanced at Ji Changkong who had his head lowered over there, and said calmly: "Changkong, be more serious next time."

"I understand, uncle. I will cook the dishes tomorrow so that you won't be unable to eat them." Ji Changkong lowered his head, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes, but he whispered softly.

Ji Changkong's biological grandfather, Ji Yusheng, put down the porcelain bowl in his hand, and suddenly said angrily: "Cooking, cooking! I know how to cook! A man from the Ji family can only work hard on such lowly things, what else can you do?"

After a pause, Ji Yusheng saw Ji Changkong lowered his head and said nothing. He slammed the table and shouted angrily: "You know clearly that a distinguished guest is coming today, but you still get yourself dirty. You don't even change into clean clothes. You don't understand the general situation!" As soon as he finished speaking, Ji Yusheng threw away the chopsticks in his hand and stood up with a cold snort.

Ji Yusheng's outburst was a bit sudden, without any warning in advance. Everyone looked at each other, temporarily put down their bowls and chopsticks, and stared at him blankly.

Ji Changle, who had glared at Ji Changkong before, had eyes full of schadenfreude. Ji Changxiao, Ji Changsheng, and Ji Yueqing acted as if the matter had nothing to do with them. They didn't even look at Ji Changkong, but looked at Ji Yusheng strangely, wondering why he was so angry over such a trivial matter.

Ji Haohong and Ji Haoguang were sitting upright with serious expressions, while their wives, Luo Shi and Zhao, who were sitting at the small table next to them, lowered their heads slightly, with imperceptible sneers on their faces.

Only Ji Xiaolian, who was next to Ji Changkong, timidly tugged at the corner of Ji Changkong's clothes, her eyes full of sympathy.

"Dad!" Ji Wanyun stood up, looked at Ji Yusheng without fear, and said angrily: "If Changkong hadn't been unable to gather Yuan Power, he would not be worse than anyone else! As a direct descendant of the Ji family, Changkong has a hard enough time cooking for everyone every day. Occasional negligence is inevitable, and you still want to be angry with him?!"

"Ahem..." Ji Yuxing, who had been lowering his head and continuing to drink porridge, finally raised his head and put down his bowl and chopsticks, but had no intention of standing up. He looked at Ji Yusheng and frowned: "Third brother, it's because Changkong can't gather Yuanli to become a heavenly warrior.I also asked him to take care of the daily meals because of his extraordinary cooking skills.I just wanted to find something for him to do. Anyway, he can't practice, so it won't make him bored.If you don't like it, I can find someone to replace him. Why be so angry?"

"He is clumsy. I don't like to eat the food he cooks anyway!" Ji Yusheng glared at Ji Changkong fiercely, waved his hands and walked away. When he got outside the door, he murmured in a low voice: "The food cooked by Xiaozhou is delicious, I like him!"

"Haohong, starting tomorrow, let Xiaozhou continue to be responsible for daily meals." Ji Yuxing shouted to his eldest son Ji Haohong before Ji Yusheng's figure disappeared.

"I know, dad." Ji Haohong nodded in agreement and glanced at Ji Changkong, who was bowing his head and saying nothing, unintentionally, a trace of displeasure flashed in his eyes.

"It's time for the city lord to come. You should finish your meal quickly and go to Qingyan Mountain early to prepare for the test. Which little brat is too late to be locked up in the Ice Cave for three days!" Ji Yuxing stood up and was about to leave when he suddenly glanced at Ji Changkong unintentionally and thought for a moment., then frowned and said: "Changkong will stay and clear the table. You can't gather Yuanli anyway. It doesn't matter whether you come to this test or not." After saying this, Ji Yuxing's figure flashed, and he, who had reached Liuhetian's strength, had disappeared in an instant.

As soon as Ji Yuxing left, Ji Haohong and Ji Haoguang didn't even look at Ji Changkong. They just nodded to Ji Wanyun, wiped their mouths with a wet cloth and left immediately, followed closely by their wives Luo Shi and Zhao Shi.

"I'll take care of you after the test is over, hum!" Ji Changle glared at Ji Changkong fiercely, and didn't care to continue eating. When passing by Ji Changkong, he whispered in a voice that only the two of them could hear.Then he hurried to Qingyan Mountain with Ji Changxiao and Ji Changsheng, for fear that if he went late, he would be imprisoned in the Ice Cave for three days.

"Brother Changkong, it's all Brother Changle's vomiting that made Third Grandpa angry. Don't be sad." Ji Xiaolian tugged at the corner of Ji Changkong's clothes, with bright big eyes and round little face, she pouted her little mouth and softly comforted Ji Changkong.

"Let's go, Xiaolian, don't you want to be imprisoned in the Ice Cave, right?" Ji Yueqing frowned and shouted softly before Ji Changkong could speak. She seemed not to like Ji Xiaolian and Ji Changkong having more contact, so she grabbed Ji Xiaolian and pulled her out before she could finish her speech.

Ji Xiaolian stuck out her tongue, waved to Ji Changkong, and ran out with Ji Yueqing.

When only he and Ji Wanyun were left in the dining room, Ji Changkong, who had been hanging his head, drank the last mouthful of porridge, and then raised his head, with a faint smile on his face, as if he was not affected by Ji Yusheng's scolding at all, and he was not angry or irritable, nor was he flattered or insulted.

"Changkong, don't blame your grandpa. In the entire Ji family, the one who loves you the most is not your aunt, but your grandpa!" Seeing everyone left, Ji Wanyun sighed softly and said quietly.

"Aunt, of course I know that grandpa did this because he felt sorry for me. Hey, it's my failure and it's also hard for grandpa. In order for me to save some energy, he actually had to waste so much effort." Ji Changkong sighed.

When Ji Changkong said this, Ji Wanyun burst into laughter, touched Ji Changkong's head, and said happily: "You kid, you are smarter and more sensible than those little bastards, and you are always so reassuring. If you can one day gather your energy to become a heavenly warrior, I think none of those bastards in Changle can compare to you!"
